description: Delete a resource and all of its data, such as every table and row in a database. This cannot be undone, so confirm with the user first. A resource attached to any app is refused, and the answer names those apps: detach it from each with detach_resource, then delete it. The provider removes it in the background. Deleting a resource that is already being deleted changes nothing. Requires connecting a Valet account.

org_name.description: The Valet organization the resource belongs to. Omit to use the organization the account joined first.

resource.description: Required. The resource's name in the organization.

name: delete_resource
title: Delete a resource
